creatures_evolved_state_consistent.name: creatures_evolved_state_consistent
creatures_evolved_state_consistent.value:
("creatures"."is_evolved" = false and "creatures"."evolved_at" is null)
          or ("creatures"."is_evolved" = true and "creatures"."evolved_at" is not null and "creatures"."evolution_path_id" is not null)

eggs_hatched_state_consistent.name: eggs_hatched_state_consistent
eggs_hatched_state_consistent.value:
("eggs"."status" <> 'hatched' and "eggs"."hatched_at" is null and "eggs"."creature_id" is null)
          or ("eggs"."status" = 'hatched' and "eggs"."hatched_at" is not null)

eggs_spoiled_state_consistent.name: eggs_spoiled_state_consistent
eggs_spoiled_state_consistent.value:
("eggs"."status" <> 'spoiled' and "eggs"."spoiled_at" is null)
          or ("eggs"."status" = 'spoiled' and "eggs"."spoiled_at" is not null)

battles_finished_has_ended_at.name: battles_finished_has_ended_at
battles_finished_has_ended_at.value: ("battles"."status" = 'active' and "battles"."ended_at" is null) or ("battles"."status" <> 'active' and "battles"."ended_at" is not null)
